correctness.rationale: For normalized \(q\in\mathcal H_{2,1}(\mathbb C^n)\), the focal source gives \(\kappa_4=1296(s+3h/2)\), \(h\ge0\), and \(\kappa_4=(3/2)(m-2)\) with \(m=\mathbb E|q|^4\). Normalization gives \(\operatorname{tr}G=1/6\), so \(s=1/(36r_{\mathrm{eff}})\). Hence \(m-2\ge24/r_{\mathrm{eff}}\). Positivity of \(G\) and Cauchy--Schwarz give \(r_{\mathrm{eff}}\le\operatorname{rank}G\le2n\), yielding \(m-2\ge12/n\).
